items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: So my mother remarried Charles Jackson, he was a brick major.

ctx.x: Okay, it's going now. I guess the first thing we should get is your right name.

Well, I was christened James Preston MacDonald. But you see, my mother and father separated, about three years old. So my mother remarried Charles Jackson, he was a brick major. And so I take the name of Jackson, I used my middle name Preston. His name was Charles Jackson. Yeah.
I noticed Preston J. Jackson when you signed it.
